title: Barriss Offee
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Barriss Offee was the Mirialan Padawan of Jedi Master Luminara Unduli. They trained together in tandem and fought valiantly against the Droid army at the first battle of Geonosis, helping rescue Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Padmé Amidala. Barriss was distrustful of the way the Jedi were heading and, though her intentions were noble, they still took her down a dark path.
